findings.title: `queued` is fixed at module import rather than source creation
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated when this module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` constructed without an explicit `queued` value receives the same timestamp for the lifetime of the worker process. Consequently the serialized source metadata does not represent when an inbound assignment was queued. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so each source gets its own creation timestamp.
